title: Pure Primite
summary: Pure Primite control paired with a rainbow of generic Normal Monsters, Polymerization and staples. The Normal Monsters span six different Attributes and four Types so Primite Imperial Dragon's GY-based board banish catches almost any opposing field.

summary.title: Starters
points: Primite Dragon Ether Beryl Sets a Primite Spell/Trap straight from the Deck on Normal Summon, Tributes itself to send any Normal Monster from the Deck to the GY, and returns to the hand from the GY during your Standby Phase while you have a Normal Monster on the field or in the GY.
Primite Lordly Lode searches any Primite card on activation, and once per turn lets you declare a Normal Monster name to Special Summon it from the hand, Deck or GY in Defense Position.
Primite Roar pays 2000 LP to Special Summon a declared Normal Monster from the Deck and makes your Normal Monsters and Primite monsters immune to battle destruction for the turn.

summary.title: Opening: Ether Beryl or Lordly Lode
steps: Normal Summon Primite Dragon Ether Beryl to Set Primite Lordly Lode from the Deck, then activate Lordly Lode to search Primite Drillbeam or Primite Imperial Dragon.

Tribute Ether Beryl to mill a Normal Monster matching the opponent's Attribute or Type (or Frostosaurus for a 2600 ATK body), then use Lordly Lode to Special Summon a Normal Monster from the Deck or GY.
Set Primite Drillbeam and Primite Scream; on the opponent's Main Phase, Primite Imperial Dragon can Normal Summon itself as a Quick Effect by Tributing that Normal Monster.

summary.title: Primite Imperial Dragon & Nether Berzelius
points: Primite Imperial Dragon Normal Summons itself during the opponent's Main Phase by Tributing 1 Normal Monster; on Tribute Summon, it negates the effects of all face-up monsters the opponent currently controls and banishes every opposing monster whose Type or Attribute matches any Normal Monster in your GY.

Alexandrite Dragon (LIGHT Dragon), Luster Dragon (WIND Dragon), Gene-Warped Warwolf (EARTH Beast-Warrior), Vorse Raider (DARK Beast-Warrior), Blazing Inpachi (FIRE Pyro) and Frostosaurus (WATER Dinosaur) cover every main Attribute in the GY for Imperial Dragon.

Primite Dragon Nether Berzelius, fused with Polymerization using a Primite monster and 1 or more Normal Monsters, gains 1000 ATK per additional material and continuously negates the activated effects of opposing monsters whose Level or Rank is less than or equal to the number of Normal Monsters on your field and in your GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Primite Drillbeam reveals a Primite card or Normal Monster in hand (or fires for free while you control a Normal Monster or Level 5+ Primite) to negate a face-up card on the field and banish it, then Sets itself from the GY during your Main Phase while you control a Primite monster.
Primite Scream (Counter Trap) negates a Normal or Special Summon and banishes that monster while you control a Normal Monster or Level 5+ Primite, and resets itself from the GY.

Primite Howl summons a declared Normal Monster and banishes itself from the GY on the opponent's turn to take control of an opposing monster with less ATK than a Normal Monster on your field or in your GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Primite Fusion is not yet released in the TCG, so the deck uses a single Polymerization to summon Primite Dragon Nether Berzelius.

exclude.Primite Fusion: Not released in the TCG yet.

main: Normal Summoned: Sets a Primite Spell/Trap from the Deck; Tributes itself to mill a Normal Monster.
Tribute Summoned off a Normal Monster: negates their monsters and banishes those sharing a Type or Attribute with your GY's Normals.
Searches a Primite card, and summons a declared Normal Monster from the hand, Deck or GY.
Quick-Play: negates and banishes a face-up card; Sets itself again from the GY.
Summons a declared Normal Monster from the Deck; from the GY, banishes a weaker monster.
Summons a declared Normal Monster; from the GY, borrows a stronger opposing monster.
2025 support. Counter Trap: negates and banishes a summon; Sets itself again (the page calls it Primite Echo).
Generic WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster: 2600 ATK for Lordly Lode to summon.
Makes Nether Berzelius until Primite Fusion reaches the TCG.
extra: Newest support. Primite + Normal Monsters: negates their monsters whose Level or Rank is at most your Normal count.
